claims.text: The FDA methadone label says opioids with alcohol may cause profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.
claims.quote: Concomitant use of opioids with benzodiazepines or other central nervous system (CNS) depressants, including alcohol, may result in profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

claims.text: The French label says alcohol increases methadone's sedative effect.
claims.quote: Majoration par l’alcool de l'effet sédatif de la méthadone.

headline.text: The FDA methadone label links alcohol co-use to profound sedation, respiratory depression, coma, and death.

reported.text: The French label also describes increased sedation with alcohol and methadone.

gaps.text: The packet contains no controlled human study of alcohol with methadone.
